        FROM OPENJSON(@pjsonfile, '$.factoryRunUsages')

        [factoryRunRef] NVARCHAR(50) NULL,
        [promptTokens] INT NULL,
        [completionTokens] INT NULL,
        [totalTokens] INT NULL,
        [costUSD] DECIMAL(10,2) NULL,
        [modelName] NVARCHAR(100) NULL,
        [timestamp] DATETIME NULL
    );

    BEGIN TRY
        INSERT INTO @payload ([factoryRunUsageId], [factoryRunRef], [promptTokens], [completionTokens], [totalTokens], [costUSD], [modelName], [timestamp])
        SELECT [factoryRunUsageId], [factoryRunRef], [promptTokens], [completionTokens], [totalTokens], [costUSD], [modelName], [timestamp]
        FROM OPENJSON(@pjsonfile, '$.factoryRunUsages')
        WITH (
        [factoryRunUsageId] INT '$.factoryRunUsageId',
        [factoryRunRef] NVARCHAR(50) '$.factoryRunRef',
        [promptTokens] INT '$.promptTokens',

        [totalTokens] INT '$.totalTokens',
        [costUSD] DECIMAL(10,2) '$.costUSD',
        [modelName] NVARCHAR(100) '$.modelName',
        [timestamp] DATETIME '$.timestamp'
        );

        BEGIN TRANSACTION;

        IF @action = 1

            INSERT INTO [dbo].[factoryRunUsages] ([factoryRunRef], [promptTokens], [completionTokens], [totalTokens], [costUSD], [modelName], [timestamp], [created_At])

                t.[updated_at] = GETDATE()
            FROM [dbo].[factoryRunUsages] AS t
            INNER JOIN @payload AS p ON t.[factoryRunUsageId] = p.[factoryRunUsageId];

            SET @Outputmessage = JSON_MODIFY(@Outputmessage, '$.result[0].msg', 'Invalid action');

            GOTO Finish;
        END

        COMMIT TRANSACTION;
    END TRY

            ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
